sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
test steps for the Synchrocheck Relay device using secondary injection devices 
ISA Test Set Type ART/3 or Omicron to ensure the correct operation of it.

There are eight opto isolated inputs to the relay that can be 
arranged to operate up to 16 alternative ladder inputs, which perform functions 
assigned to them in the ladder diagram, as determined by the setting of the 
INPUT MASKS and so making maximum use of the available control inputs.

Software 
filtering is applied to eliminate the adverse effects of induced ac signals in 
the external wiring. Eight programmable output relays are provided on all 
models. These relays can be arranged to operate in response to any, or all, of 
up to 16 alternative ladder outputs, whose function is assigned in the ladder 
diagram, by suitably setting the OUTPUT MASKS.

In addition there is a watchdog 
relay for external indication of equipment failure/healthy status. Measurements 
are only available in relays including check synchronism features (KAVS and KAVR). 
These relays have two voltage transformers for measuring line and bus bar 
voltages.

Safety 
Precautions

A work permit must be issued, maintenance 
 staff must carry the suitable safety ID category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,

Safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, and 
 safety Helmet .. etc

Line 
isolation is required

sections.text: Work to be carried out
Relays Preparation
Review the manual and drawings.

Prepare the previous or commissioning results of the 
relay testing.
Check the wires of the relay by hand.
Check the AC source is available to the tester.
Check the existence of the DC sources in panels.

Disconnect the outputs of the relay and 
connect one of them to the timer of the tester.
Check all the leads used in tests.

sections.text: Test Steps

Connect the voltage leads of a tester unit to the 
relay points according to the drawings and scheme.
Inject voltage to each couple of points.

Repeat the steps for each pair of points according to the 
test sheet.
Record the results.
